The smallest byte set that makes it run is three substitutions: the rename, removing plan.targetPath from protectedPaths, and skipping the backup-move of the target itself. The captain RULED that all three land inside t5 (acceptance #2 requires execution), so the two corrections were landed on attempt 2 — see stepACompletion below.

deliberatelyNotRenamed.reason: DOCUMENTED FLOOR — persisted migration state, not branding. It is (1) appended to the user's own ~/.mpd/config.jsonc `_migrations` marker (markerValue 8305-8313) and is the re-run guard (hasMigrationMarker 8231, plan decision 8236, journal resume 8628); (2) stored as `migrationId` in ~/.mpd/.migration-journal.json (8400/8433/8741/8759); (3) the backup-name fallback via encodeURIComponent(migrationId) (8681-8682). Renaming it would make every already-migrated user look unmigrated and re-run a migration on their live config.

openDecisionForCaptain: STEP A's stated acceptance ('the previously dead path now executes') is NOT satisfiable by the scoped one-token fix alone. Two further corrections are needed and both change migration semantics, so they need an explicit ruling: (i) drop plan.targetPath from assertSafeSourcePaths' protectedPaths (executePlan 8734); (ii) skip the backup-move when move.from === plan.targetPath (8776-8781). Evidence for the combined remedy: variant v5 in raw/02-step-a-causality.json.

Consequence of landing (i)+(ii): after migration the config stays at ~/.mpd/config.jsonc (rewritten) and a timestamped .bak sibling is created, instead of the config being relocated into migration-backup-<stamp>-legacy-config/.mpd/. That is a behaviour change outside the codegraph brand scope and outside t5's frozen description, hence the report rather than a silent land.

Also needed before 'lands green': the staged bundle for the codegraph-smoke gate (dist/mpd-package is gitignored; codegraph-smoke exits 1 with 'missing staged bundle' on the pristine tree, so that RED is environmental, not caused by this change).
